title: Complete functional touchpoint audit evidence
summary: Build an exact, generated WebView touchpoint ledger and evidence overlay; exercise static and runtime-generated controls through isolated browser and native-shell probes; and repair deterministic interaction, accessibility, row-open, Pipeline Log, and event-ownership failures discovered by the audit.
reason: The functional audit lacked one authoritative denominator for authored, generated, auxiliary-window, and native-shell controls. Several safe controls were either unclassified, ambiguously identified, wired more than once, inaccessible from the keyboard, unavailable without backend row state, or unable to open the native Pipeline Log window under the Tauri capability model.
behavior_before: Touchpoint coverage was distributed across static checks and feature smokes without a generated exact-control ledger or a consolidated evidence overlay. Repeated controls could not always be mapped stably; generated row-open buttons could begin enabled without selected-row availability evidence; some keyboard paths and dynamic actions were not exercised; duplicate filter listeners existed; the Metrics attention action lacked a stable selector; Completed size-evidence selection called undefined dependency names; and the Tauri Pipeline Log bridge lacked generated command permission and isolated native-window evidence.
behavior_after: The audit now has a deterministic authored-control ledger, a separately counted generated/native evidence model, stable touchpoint annotations, isolated control-census tests, and a permanent final report. Backend-owned row availability and busy state gate generated open actions, duplicated event ownership is removed, affected Home/Metrics/Diagnostics/Completed controls have direct interaction regressions, the Pipeline Log bridge invokes the exact read-only Tauri command with browser fallback, and the Tauri manifest/capability/UIA surfaces model that command explicitly. Final browser, WebView, Tauri, generated-context, diff, postflight, and strict change-packet gates are recorded in this packet and the report with blocked native/real-media limits kept explicit.
